items.headline: Adobe seems to be fully embracing AI prompt-based editing in Photoshop
items.excerpt: Adobe has launched a new AI Assisted Editor mode in Photoshop, where the whole edit is driven by prompts rather than tools. It signals how far Adobe is willing to push prompt-first editing into a pro workflow.

items.headline: This indie dev found a use for AI but says the project was still firmly human led
items.excerpt: HaZ Dulull turned his own pixel-art game into an animated series using AI tools, but insists the creative direction stayed human-led. A concrete look at where AI sits inside a small creative pipeline.

items.headline: A Visual Interface Between Humans and Coding Agents
items.excerpt: Pixy is an attempt to give coding agents a visual surface humans can actually steer, instead of a wall of terminal text. It reframes design-to-code handoff as a shared canvas problem.

items.headline: Cursor is now available in the AI SDK harness layer
items.excerpt: Cursor now runs through Vercel's AI SDK harness layer via @ai-sdk/harness-cursor, using the same HarnessAgent interface as every other supported harness. Design-to-code agents become swappable infrastructure.

items.headline: What Blade Runner got wrong about AI (so far)
items.excerpt: A designer re-reads Blade Runner's predictions against the AI interfaces we actually shipped. The gap between cinematic AI and everyday product AI turns out to be a design story.

items.headline: AI has a hospitality problem money can't fix
items.excerpt: Dan Maccarone argues AI products keep failing at hospitality — the felt sense of being hosted — and no amount of model spend fixes it. It puts service design back at the center of AI UX.

items.headline: The Design System as the Control Plane for AI-Generated UI
items.excerpt: When agents can generate a form, dashboard or modal on demand, the design system stops being a component library and becomes the control plane that constrains what AI is allowed to produce.

items.headline: How Allegro Builds AI-First Design Systems for Predictable Scale
items.excerpt: A case study on how Allegro restructured its design system so AI generation produces predictable, on-brand output at scale. Tokens and governance do the heavy lifting.

items.headline: Create Seamless PSX Textures from Photos with Cycletex: Retro Texture
items.excerpt: Cycletex: Retro Texture turns ordinary photos into seamless 32-bit-era textures, compressing a fiddly manual step in retro art pipelines into one pass.

items.headline: Adobe Unveils New Photoshop AI Tools
items.excerpt: Photoshop gains a non-destructive Light Adjustment Layer, Firefly Image 5-powered Instruct Edit with Masks, visual Markup prompting, and a beta AI Assisted Editor. The update pushes prompting into layer-level craft.

items.headline: Autodesk's Own Luke Mihelcic on Judging the Fusion Forward Competition
items.excerpt: Autodesk's Luke Mihelcic warns designers against outsourcing creativity and critical thinking to AI, even while championing what it opens up in Fusion-based industrial design work.

items.headline: Human-in-the-loop AI is becoming the default, not the exception
items.excerpt: Organizations are wiring human oversight into AI workflows as a default rather than a safety valve, changing how review, approval and accountability get designed into tools.

items.headline: Google Flow brings new creative control features to enhance video editing
items.excerpt: Google Flow adds new creative controls on top of Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, giving video creators finer direction over generated footage instead of one-shot prompting.

items.headline: This rebrand of a voice-journalling app looks lovely, but is an 'AI illustration system' the right call?
items.excerpt: The Working Assembly built Untold's new identity around a generative 'AI illustration system' that deliberately avoids gen-AI cliches. It's a live test of whether AI can be a brand system, not just a shortcut.

items.headline: Communicating Your Vision with Intention Using AI | Leading Creative Projects with AI
items.excerpt: Adobe's series on leading creative projects with AI turns to the hardest part: communicating creative intent clearly enough that AI-assisted teams land the vision.

items.headline: Spice up your content with image-to-video in Adobe Firefly
items.excerpt: A walkthrough of Firefly's image-to-video, turning existing stills and brand assets into motion without leaving the Adobe pipeline.
